title: The salary dispute that ended his time with Boyd
summary: A loan with promised salary was not honored by Boyd and his backer, so Handy said goodbye.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: When I started to hassle with Boyd, and his manager, who was somebody new--his backer.
What was the nature of that hassle; we haven't gotten to that?

I borrowed--what the hell was it--two thousand dollars, three thousand dollars--with the understanding that they were going to pay me a salary of five hundred a week, starting immediately and that after two months, I think it was, I would accept half salary until the debt was paid back. So we shook hands on the agreement, the end of the first week everybody gets their checks except me. I said, 'where's my check, Boyd?' 'Oh, Stirling is out of town, he'll be back next week, we'll give you double

next week, but hey look, you got five hundred dollars knocked off your debt already." I said "that's not the point, it's not our agreement; our agreement was for full salary for two months and then half salary until it's paid off." "Well, he'll be back and we'll get it straightened out." I said I want a guarantee that I'm going to get the right money next week. You've got it. Next week comes, no check again. I said where's my money, how am I going to live? Ain't this great, you paid back a thousand already. I said man, this is not our agreement, I can't go on like this, Boyd, you're going to have to straighten this out. He said, well, Stilman is away again, he's out of town, we'll have to wait for him to get back. I said Boyd, if it isn't right next week, I'm going to have to leave. He said it will be right, don't you worry.
So the following week, no check-- (tape went blank for a few seconds)--"I have one thing to say to you and that is goodbye." That was it.
Was that Boyd's way, normally, of doing business, or was that pressure from his manager?
Did he ever have that kind of pattern before?

They both made the agreement with me. They were both present during the discussion, the agreement, I shook hands with both of them. Two months of full salary and half until it's paid back. I wasn't going to take more than three weeks of being screwed like that.
What was the time; was that the moment of--was that halfway through "Over the Rainbow" to put a time on it? Is that why "Over the Rainbow" was incomplete?
Oh, no, this was after that. This was months later.
This was after the recording session?
